name: Sodium Citrate Enema (Micralax)
mechanism: Osmotic + softening - draws water into rectum
contraindications: Suspected or known bowel obstruction, significant rectal bleeding of unknown cause
interactions: None of clinical significance for rectal use
monitoring: Confirm bowel evacuation and watch for abdominal pain or severe rectal bleeding post administration
pregnancy: Considered safe for occasional use in pregnancy for constipation under clinical guidance
sideEffects: Local irritation, abdominal cramps, rare allergic reactions
pharmacokinetics: Local rectal action with rapid onset (usually within 5–30 minutes)
clinicalPearls: Small-volume, rapid-onset micro-enema useful for quick relief or pre-procedural bowel clearance; preferred over phosphate enemas in many settings due to lower systemic absorption
indication: Acute constipation and pre-procedure rectal/colonic clearance
